## Operational Philosophy
Nepali Tales operates on a strict fresh-batch kitchen model. Handcrafted momo and broths are freshly prepped daily. Orders are scheduled ahead via designated ordering windows, and customers can either pick up fresh from the kitchen counter or receive delivery via on-demand couriers across Thane and Mumbai.
